_readme: TMP_009 iteration 9 — PO-requested model probe. Swap base from `terrain-realisticfantasy-v30` → `hezi-ultimate-jp-kr-v10` (heziUltimateJapaneseAndKorean SDXL 1.0). Same iter 6 prompt config (proven peak): drop 'map', force 'single specimen'. Same zero LoRA, same fixture. Risk: model name suggests character/portrait training; iter 3 with a similar character-trained base (Illustrious) collapsed to anime faces. ~2 min iteration cost to confirm or refute.
